name: Pit Bull – Professional Lap Dog (72 LBS)
title: Pit Bull – Professional Lap Dog (72 LBS) Ornament
story: This pitbull ornament is for the person whose 72-pound pit bull is sure it is a lap dog: a Christmas tree ornament that is also an easy stocking gift for any pittie owner.

The print is a grinning gray pit bull spread across a tiny flowered armchair, tongue out and paws on the arms, under PROFESSIONAL LAP DOG in heavy cream slab capitals, with the (72 LBS) punchline underneath on a deep navy disc. The art matches our Professional Lap Dog hoodie, so the ornament makes a set with the hoodie.

Every pit bull owner knows the evening: the dog climbs into a lap, then keeps climbing until there is no lap left, and nobody asks it to move. The ornament says it in two lines and a weight. Hang it on the tree where the dog will not reach it, tuck it into a stocking, or tie it to a gift for the friend who has a dog like this. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.
joke_a: A pit bull that weighs 72 pounds and still climbs into your lap is the whole joke, and the (72 LBS) under the title lands it. The Professional Lap Dog ornament from Graphic Tees Co. prints the grinning dog in his tiny armchair, so any pit bull owner reads it at once on the tree.
